![《我的世界》中一隻貓坐在床上，窗外下著雨的場景。頂部以暖橘色顯示「Gentler Weather Sounds」字樣](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cdd19c0824419a3684ae022c4046cff6f0321516.jpeg)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

我從來不滿意《我的世界》的天氣音效，覺得它們要不就是刺耳、要不就是不搭調，或者單純聽起來不夠悅耳，所以我製作了「Gentler Weather Sounds（溫和天氣音效）」！這個模組將《我的世界》的天氣音效替換為更悅耳的版本，完整替換了下雨與雷聲／閃電的音頻！

建議搭配 Extended Weather Radius 使用！

如果您只需要下雨音效或僅需閃電與雷聲，請分別使用 Gentler Rain Sounds 或 Better Lightning Sounds！

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

本預覽影片使用 2.2.0 版本錄製
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

- **我可以將此模組用於整合包或伺服器嗎？** 可以，請盡力從令人難以忍受的原版下雨音效中拯救更多人吧！ - **您會支援其他模組的天氣系統嗎？** 我持開放態度，但該模組必須有預設音效，且我認為它在《我的世界》中過於刺耳或不搭調。目前我不會單純為了替換而替換。 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

使用的音效 未列名出處的音效皆由本人設計／錄製 所有音效均已經過調整，以確保能更好地融合播放 [https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/rain-and-thunder-nature-sounds-7803/](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/rain-and-thunder-nature-sounds-7803/) [https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/soft-rain-ambient-111154/](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/soft-rain-ambient-111154/) [https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/natural-thunder-113219/](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/natural-thunder-113219/) [https://freesound.org/people/bone666138/sounds/198857/](https://freesound.org/people/bone666138/sounds/198857/) [https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/thunder-24571/](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/thunder-24571/) [https://freesound.org/people/shelbyshark/sounds/513394/](https://freesound.org/people/shelbyshark/sounds/513394/) [https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/copyright-free-rain-sounds-331497/](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/copyright-free-rain-sounds-331497/) [https://freesound.org/people/Soundrack/sounds/733288/](https://freesound.org/people/Soundrack/sounds/733288/) [https://freesound.org/people/Spennnyyy/sounds/350506/](https://freesound.org/people/Spennnyyy/sounds/350506/) [https://freesound.org/people/jrosin/sounds/329978/](https://freesound.org/people/jrosin/sounds/329978/) [https://freesound.org/people/dobroide/sounds/41365/](https://freesound.org/people/dobroide/sounds/41365/) [https://freesound.org/people/fattirewhitey/sounds/523905/](https://freesound.org/people/fattirewhitey/sounds/523905/) [https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/calm-rain-ambience-421001/](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/calm-rain-ambience-421001/) [https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/nature-winter-rain-in-oak-forest-loop-185672/](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/nature-winter-rain-in-oak-forest-loop-185672/)
